title: Players with Good or Bad Playoff Schedules
brief: Which players' teams have strong or weak schedules in weeks 19 to 21 ending 2027-03-28, especially two-game weeks? It must say that this list is a tiebreaker between similar players and matters most for expensive players.
summary: The playoff schedule (weeks 19 to 21, ending 2027-03-28) is a tiebreaker between similar players and matters most for the expensive players who take the biggest share of your 200 USD. The two weeks that hurt most are Minnesota's two-game semifinal week (week 20) and Cleveland's two-game finals week (week 21). Dallas, Phoenix and Memphis play 4-4-4, while Houston, Portland, Miami, Indiana, Brooklyn and the Lakers get only about 10 games.

sections.heading: A tiebreaker, not a draft plan

paragraphs.text: Every method note agrees on one thing. At the draft, the playoff schedule is the least important factor. Use it only to choose between two players you rate about the same. Never take a worse player because his team has a better schedule. It should not shape your draft plan.

The schedule matters most for your most expensive players. In our auction those are the players who take the biggest share of your 200 USD. You do not want your best player stuck with two games in the semifinal or the final. For mid-price and 1 USD flyers, the schedule matters much less. Do not let it stop you from taking a late chance.

What to check: count each team's games in weeks 19, 20 and 21 using the March 28 end. A two-game week is the worst case. Also check back-to-backs for players who sit them. Kyrie Irving's 4-4-4 could shrink to about 10 games if he rests on back-to-backs. Joel Embiid's 3-4-4 could drop to about 8 games because of three playoff back-to-backs.

The experts disagree on how hard to mark down a two-game week. One says that in head-to-head leagues a two-game playoff week should drop a player down your board. The other notes are softer. Move him down only a little, and only when you are choosing between similar players. The same first expert also says to take an early pick with a two-game week if he falls far enough and nothing better is left. In practice, lower your maximum bid on these players a little. Do not pass on them at a fair price.

sections.heading: The two-game weeks: Minnesota and Cleveland

paragraphs.text: Minnesota plays 4, 2 and 4 games. The two-game week starts March 15, in our semifinal. This hits Anthony Edwards, LaMelo Ball, Rudy Gobert, Jaden McDaniels, Ayo Dosunmu and Jonathan Kuminga. The experts put Edwards at about 40 to 45 USD rather than the market's 60 USD, partly because of this week.

Cleveland plays 4, 3 and 2 games. The two-game week starts March 22, in our final. This hits Donovan Mitchell, James Harden, Evan Mobley, Jarrett Allen and Peyton Watson. Cleveland also plays a lot of back-to-backs, so check who sits them.

Up to three players from one NBA team is fine. More is acceptable when the team has no two-game playoff week, and five is too many. So keep it to one or two Minnesota or Cleveland players. Edwards, Ball and Gobert together would put three of your players on two games in the semifinal.

sections.heading: Expensive players: where the schedule breaks ties

paragraphs.text: Good schedules at the top: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Cade Cunningham play 4-3-4. Cooper Flagg's Dallas plays 4-4-4.

Weak schedules at the top, without a two-game week: Luka Doncic and Tyrese Haliburton play 3-4-3. Giannis Antetokounmpo plays 4-3-3 but has no back-to-backs. Kevin Durant and Amen Thompson play 3-3-4. Scottie Barnes has three Toronto back-to-backs. Karl-Anthony Towns has a weak Knicks schedule.

How to use this at the auction: say you value Flagg and Durant about the same and both will cost about the same. Then Dallas's 4-4-4 beats Houston's 3-3-4, so push one more bid on Flagg. If your values clearly favor one player, ignore the schedule.

sections.heading: Mid and late rounds, and the trade deadline

paragraphs.text: In the mid and late rounds, treat a good schedule as a small bonus. Phoenix plays 4-4-4 for Devin Booker. Memphis plays 4-4-4 for Cameron Boozer, Zach Edey and Ty Jerome. New Orleans plays 4-4-3 for Trey Murphy III and Dejounte Murray, and the Clippers play 4-3-4 for Darius Garland.

Some weak-schedule players are worth drafting and then selling before the 2027-03-04 deadline if they hold value. The notes name Deni Avdija and Damian Lillard (Portland, 10 games, three back-to-backs), OG Anunoby (Knicks) and Andrew Wiggins (Miami, 10 games). Julius Randle's Brooklyn has only 10 games and may rest him in March.

sections.heading: Waiver moves for the playoff weeks

paragraphs.text: Teams playing 4-4-4 are where to look for March streamers. You can make up to 6 adds per week. Dillon Brooks and Luke Kennard on Phoenix are named as useful playoff pickups for threes. Mark Williams could help a punt 3PM team if he returns from his labrum injury in March. Moses Moody's likely March return lines up with a good Golden State schedule.
